profile_title: Who takes responsibility for the result
profile_lead: {{FOUNDER_NAME}} is a structural engineer with 20+ years of experience. Over that period, 1500+ concrete staircases have been delivered: from classic monolithic layouts to complex architectural nodes.
profile_point_1: Personal control of geometry, reinforcement, and critical technical nodes at every stage.
profile_point_2: Clear communication on timeline, milestones, and actual on-site progress.
profile_point_3: Technical decisions are aligned before start to avoid costly rework on site.
profile_story_note: We take only those projects where we can ensure technically correct execution, clear timelines, and stable quality.
